#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

int main() {
    std::string s;
    std::getline(std::cin, s);
    
    std::vector<int> starts;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.length(); i++) {
        if (i == 0 || s[i] != s[i - 1]) {
            starts.push_back(static_cast<int>(i));
        }
    }
    
    int ans = 0;
    for (size_t k = 0; k < starts.size(); k++) {
        int end = (k + 1 < starts.size()) ? starts[k + 1] : static_cast<int>(s.length());
        if (((end - starts[k]) & 1) == 0) {
            ans++;
        }
    }
    
    std::cout << ans << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
